correctness.rationale: For an initially uniform angle and Poisson i.i.d. turn increments with first harmonic z and second w, the angular Fourier generator has decay rates a_j=alpha(1-m_j). The second/fourth moment hierarchy yields a linear asymptotic fourth-cumulant rate K=3v^4/alpha^3[Re((1-z)^-2(1-w)^-1)-2 Re((1-z)^-1)Re((1-z)^-2)] for |z|<1,w!=1. All second harmonics obey |w-z²|<=1-|z|², and the entire disk is feasible via two-atom chord laws and mixtures. Inverting 1-w maps the disk to another disk if Im z !=0 or half-plane when Im z=0, and direct affine optimization gives the full stated sharp K intervals, attaining boundary turn laws and sign thresholds. Independent exact rational boundary witnesses for z=i/2 gave K=162/125 and -288/125, with a zero sharp upper bound at z=(1+i)/2; an independent generator-based check corroborated the moment normalizations. Nonrelaxing w=1 and |z|=1 excluded.
